name: Sheraton Istanbul Levent
positioning: City hotel in Istanbul's Levent district near business hubs and shopping centers, with a spa, indoor pool and a peaceful garden
best_for: Business travelers who want a base near Levent's business hubs and the metro
City travelers who want a spa and indoor pool after a day of exploring

facts.text: The hotel is at Buyukdere Caddesi No 3-4 in 4 Levent, Kagithane, Istanbul.
The hotel is close to major business hubs and shopping centers.
The nearest subway station is 4th Levent Metro Station.
The Levantino Restaurant serves cuisine inspired by Eastern Mediterranean flavors.
Cafe by Sheraton turns into a bar at night.
The spa has separate men's and women's lounges.
The hotel has an indoor pool.
The hotel has a Sheraton Club lounge for qualifying guests.
As a Li Yu certified hotel, it offers amenities and services tailored for Chinese guests.

highlights.text: The spa has a jacuzzi, a sauna and three steam rooms.
The hotel has a peaceful garden, offering an escape in the heart of the city.
The spa offers Ayurvedic treatments and couples experiences.
Accommodations include suites and city-view rooms.
The hotel supports the Guide Dogs Association and names its meeting rooms after guide dogs.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the business-centric neighborhood may feel removed from the historic Old City attractions.
Istanbul Airport is the closest airport, about 32 kilometers from the hotel.
